CivBonuses.Name: Silver Owls
CivBonuses.History: The mines at Laureion in Attica provided Athens with a wealth of silver from which to mint her famous and highly prized coin, The Athenian Owl.
CivBonuses.Description: Workers +10% metal gather rate per phase advance.

CivBonuses.Name: Epilektoi Infantry
CivBonuses.History: The best of the hoplites were chosen to form a group of elite professional soldiers.
CivBonuses.Description: Elite Hoplites can promote to Champion Spearmen.

CivBonuses.Name: Cavalry Limit
CivBonuses.History: Classical Athens maintained a citizen cavalry corps and could supplement it with allied or mercenary horsemen, but Athenian military power rested chiefly on hoplite infantry and the fleet. Cavalry was useful for scouting, screening, raiding, and pursuit rather than serving as the army's dominant arm.
CivBonuses.Description: Maximum cavalry as a share of effective population: Village 5%; Town 10%; City 12.5%.
